_help: The one small file for homepage choices. Everything here is optional. Use an item's id: building:<slug>, writing:<slug> or video:<YouTube id>.
_featured_help: Set to an id to feature that item on the homepage; it is labelled Featured. Leave null and the newest full-length video is featured automatically, labelled Latest video.
_homeProjects_help: Up to three project ids for the homepage, in the order you want. Leave empty for the automatic choice: the newest projects with a write-up. A project does not need a picture to appear.
_hide_help: Ids listed here never appear in homepage or featured areas. Their pages and archive entries stay exactly as they are.

video:DcXaGn-NsgY.summary: A look back at my autonomous AI blog and its results. Publishing is currently paused.

_corrections_help: Only for videos, whose details come from YouTube. Use it to reword a description for the site, or to fix the title or picture of an older video that YouTube's feed no longer lists. Example: {"video:abc123def45": {"title": "A better title", "summary": "A clearer description", "thumbnail": "video/my-picture.webp"}}. Projects and writing are corrected in their own record.
